2608.26925.title: Mapping Written Words to Spoken Words in a Different Language Using Only Visual Grounding
2608.26925.paper_summary: In many low-resource settings, even just eliciting speech for data collection is difficult. One promising approach has been to ask speakers to describe images. But how do we build models from such visually grounded speech data? Given a dataset of images with Hindi spoken captions, we consider how we can map a written English keyword to spoken realisations of that word in Hindi. Previous work trained end-to-end multimodal neural models. Instead, we explore a simpler alignment-based approach built on self-supervised speech representations. Written English tags are automatically obtained from images using off-the-shelf image captioning systems. Hindi utterances associated with the same keyword are then aligned (using self-supervised features), and alignment evidence is aggregated to identify recurring speech segments corresponding to the target word. Experiments evaluating keyword spotting and localization show that our alignment-based approach outperforms a previous attention-based neural model. We also show the benefit of incorporating negative examples during alignment. Our work demonstrates that cross-lingual word-to-speech mappings can be learned directly from visual grounding without transcriptions or explicit model training.
2608.26925.paper_summary_zh: 在許多低資源環境中，僅僅獲取語音以進行數據收集都是困難的。一種有前景的方法是請說話者描述圖像。但我們如何從這種視覺基礎的語音數據中構建模型呢？考慮到一個包含印地語口述標題的圖像數據集，我們探討如何將書面英語關鍵詞映射到該詞在印地語中的口語實現。之前的工作訓練了端到端的多模態神經模型。相反，我們探索了一種基於對齊的簡單方法，該方法建立在自我監督的語音表示之上。書面英語標籤是通過現成的圖像標題系統自動從圖像中獲得的。然後，與相同關鍵詞相關的印地語話語被對齊（使用自我監督特徵），並將對齊證據聚合以識別對應於目標詞的重複語音片段。評估關鍵詞識別和定位的實驗顯示，我們的基於對齊的方法優於之前的基於注意力的神經模型。我們還展示了在對齊過程中納入負樣本的好處。我們的工作表明，跨語言的詞到語音映射可以直接從視覺基礎學習，而無需轉錄或明確的模型訓練。
